speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the appearance of your scalp and forehead rash in detail, including any itching, pain, or oozing. Have you noticed any hair loss or scaling in these areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the family history of psoriasis and the red, scaly nature of the rash are concerning. Given his age and the seasonal worsening, have you noticed if the rash appears specifically on the hair-bearing scalp or if it also involves the eyebrows or ears?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cradle Cap (Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis)
